top_headlines: Discord Patch Notes: October 6, 2026. Check out the finer details of the more technical fixes implemented into Discord recently.
SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
Sub-Quadratic Sparse Attention via Block-Spectral Routing at 1M Context. Exact self-attention scales as $O(L^2)$ in sequence length $L$, bottlenecking million-token inference.
HyperFold: Prover-Optimal Lattice Folding Schemes with Post-Quantum Soundness and $O(\log N)$ Verification
Improved Polymath Bounds on Dense Progression-Free Sets in $\mathbb{F}_p^n$ and Formalization in Lean 4
